info.name: Umuganda Management System — Midterm Verified API Tests
info.description: Based on provided Spring Boot source and midterm paper. The existing seed records must already be in PostgreSQL. Run read-only tests freely; run mutations individually, observing prerequisites. HTTP assertions test the expected status/messages; they do not replace actual backend testing.
